## Checkpoint and changes

Which checkpoint does this address, and what changed?

## Evidence and human review

- [ ] I reviewed agent-generated changes line by line instead of accepting them wholesale.
- [ ] I ran the relevant lab commands and reported their actual results, separately from what I inferred.
- [ ] Any infrastructure change shows its plan, and the plan deletes or replaces nothing.
- [ ] I did not weaken the coach, the replays, or their test cases to get a green result.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or fabricated evidence are included.
